## Team of Course Assistants

### Senior Course Assistants

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'
#| warning: false
library(yaml)

vars <- read_yaml("_variables.yml")
cas <- vars$senior_cas

if (!is.null(cas) && length(cas) > 0) {
  cat(':::: {.columns}\n\n')
  
  for (i in seq_along(cas)) {
    ca <- cas[[i]]
    
    # Left or Right column (48% width)
    cat('::: {.column width="48%"}\n')
    cat(':::: {.columns}\n')
    
    # Image column (30%)
    cat('::: {.column width="30%"}\n')
    cat(sprintf('<img src="%s" class="rounded-circle center mx-auto d-block" alt="%s" style="float: left; margin-right: 10px; width: 100%%; padding-bottom:20px;" />\n', 
                ca$image, ca$alt))
    cat(':::\n\n')
    
    # Spacer column (5%)
    cat('::: {.column width="5%"}\n:::\n\n')
    
    # Details column (65%)
    cat('::: {.column width="65%"}\n')
    
    # Audio & Name
    if (!is.null(ca$audio) && ca$audio != "") {
      cat(sprintf('[{{< fa volume-high >}}](%s){aria-label="Play audio pronunciation of %s"} %s  \n', ca$audio, ca$name, ca$name))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf('**%s**  \n', ca$name))
    }
    
    # Pronoun
    if (!is.null(ca$pronoun)) cat(sprintf('%s  \n', ca$pronoun))
    
    # Email
    if (!is.null(ca$email)) {
      cat(sprintf('[%s](mailto:%s){aria-label="Email %s" style="word-break: break-all;"}  \n', ca$email, ca$email, ca$name))
    }
    
    # Office Hours & Location
    if (!is.null(ca$`office-hours`)) cat(sprintf('<br>Office Hours: <br> %s  \n', ca$`office-hours`))
    if (!is.null(ca$office)) cat(sprintf('{{< fa building-columns title="Office Location" >}} %s\n', ca$office))
    
    cat(':::\n\n')
    cat('::::\n') # End inner .columns
    cat(':::\n\n') # End outer .column
    
    # Add a gap column between the 2 horizontal cards
    if (i %% 2 == 1 && i < length(cas)) {
      cat('::: {.column width="4%"}\n:::\n\n')
    }
    
    # Close row and start a new row after every 2 CAs
    if (i %% 2 == 0 && i < length(cas)) {
      cat('::::\n\n:::: {.columns}\n\n')
    }
  }
  
  cat('::::\n') # End main .columns container
} else {
  cat('TBD\n')
}
```
